description: Default audit rules for document verification

rules.description: Check for typos and spelling errors in the text
Check for grammar errors and sentence structure issues

examples.violation: The parties agrees to the terms.
examples.correction: The parties agree to the terms.

rules.description: Check for unclear references (ambiguous pronouns, vague terms without clear antecedents)

examples.violation: If the payment is late, it will be subject to penalties. They must pay within 30 days.
examples.correction: If the payment is late, the payment will be subject to penalties. The debtor must pay within 30 days.

rules.description: Check for logical inconsistencies (contradictions between stated facts and conclusions)

examples.violation: The contract is effective for 12 months. The parties may terminate at any time before the 6-month anniversary.
examples.correction: Clarify the relationship between contract duration and early termination rights.

rules.description: Check for vague or ambiguous monetary amounts

examples.violation: Party B shall pay approximately 10% of the total amount.
examples.correction: Party B shall pay exactly 10% of the total contract amount (RMB).

rules.description: Check for missing currency specifications in monetary values

examples.correction: The penalty amount is RMB 50,000 (fifty thousand yuan).

rules.description: Check for vague time references without specific dates

examples.violation: The deliverables shall be provided promptly after signing.
examples.correction: The deliverables shall be provided within 30 calendar days after the contract signing date.

rules.description: Check for undefined technical terms or acronyms

examples.violation: The system must comply with GDPR and SOC2 requirements.
examples.correction: The system must comply with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and SOC2 (Service Organization Control 2) requirements.

rules.description: Check for passive voice that obscures responsibility

examples.violation: The report must be submitted by the deadline.
examples.correction: Party A must submit the report by the deadline.

rules.description: Check for double negatives that create ambiguity

examples.violation: The agreement shall not be invalid unless both parties consent.
examples.correction: The agreement shall remain valid unless both parties consent to its termination.
